raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the product of photosynthesis. While it is true that chlorophyll synthesis is light-dependent, the primary biological product defined by the process of photosynthesis (converting light energy into chemical energy stored in bonds) is sugar (glucose/carbohydrates). The Planner confused the catalyst/absorber (chlorophyll) with the output product (sugar) and failed to recognize that standard educational contexts define sugar as the main product of photosynthesis.
